nodes.title: SG-5.3 Wire dust, ambient light and fade transition from content
nodes.body:
Context: game/src/engine/buildScene.ts builds only SceneObjects, and sceneSchema in game/src/content/schema.ts has no effects. Desired behavior: dust, ambient light and fade transition are authored in the scene YAML, created by the builder, and run by the Phaser BootScene. Expected result: effects exist because content declares them. Why: lets future AI cycles add effects without engine rewrites.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene YAML with an effects list, when it is parsed, then dust, ambientLight and transition entries validate and invalid ones return path-named errors
- Given a scene with effects, when buildEffects runs, then effect entities are created on the effects layer depth and a fade transition is played
- Given BootScene.create runs, when the scene content declares effects, then they are created through a Phaser-backed context and removed on shutdown


## Scope
- In scope: effects schema
- In scope: buildEffects
- In scope: Phaser effect context
- In scope: BootScene wiring
- In scope: bedroom.yaml effects
- Out of scope: new art assets
- Out of scope: backend changes
- Out of scope: scene-to-scene navigation
- Preserve: buildScene return type and RenderContext interface
- Preserve: existing SceneObject behavior
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90 APIs


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 only
- Use existing assets effect:dust and effect:glow from manifest.json
- Keep Phaser out of game/src; runtime logic uses an injected context


## Definition of done
- All three requirements have Act and Verify units passing


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Scene content declares dust, ambient light and a fade transition with validation
nodes.body:
Context: sceneSchema has no effects field. Desired: effectSchema as a discriminated union of dust (asset, count, area), ambientLight (color, alpha) and transition (type fade, durationMs). Expected: bedroom.yaml carries them and loads without errors.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a scene with valid dust, ambientLight and fade entries, when parseWorldContent('scene') runs, then ok is true
- Given a fade with negative durationMs, when parsed, then errors include a path starting with effects.0
- Given a scene without effects, when parsed, then it still validates


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/content/schema.ts
- In scope: bedroom.yaml
- Out of scope: rendering
- Preserve: objectSchema
- Preserve: existing scene fields


## Technical constraints
- zod schemas
- effects optional


## Definition of done
- Schema and content merged

- None

nodes.title: REQ · buildEffects creates effect entities from scene content on the effects layer
nodes.body:
Add EffectRenderContext and buildEffects so effects are created from content without Phaser imports, at the effects layer depth.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given scene.effects with dust, ambientLight and fade, when buildEffects runs, then createEffect is called for dust and light with depth layerDepth('effects') and playTransition once with durationMs
- Given no effects, when buildEffects runs, then nothing is created and an empty handle list returns
- Given the returned handles, when destroyed, then each effect handle destroy is called


## Scope
- In scope: game/src/engine/renderContext.ts
- In scope: game/src/engine/buildEffects.ts
- Out of scope: Phaser
- Preserve: RenderContext and buildScene unchanged


## Technical constraints
- No Phaser imports in game/src


## Definition of done
- buildEffects exported


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Phaser BootScene creates scene effects from content and cleans them up
nodes.body:
Implement EffectRenderContext on Phaser (particles for dust, tinted rectangle for light, camera fade) and call buildEffects in BootScene.create, destroying handles on shutdown.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given BootScene.create, when scene content has effects, then buildEffects is called with the Phaser context and the scene content
- Given SHUTDOWN, when it fires, then every effect handle is destroyed
- Given the Phaser context playTransition(400), when called, then cameras.main.fadeIn(400) is invoked


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/effectContext.ts
- In scope: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: scene navigation
- Preserve: sceneReady emit
- Preserve: store subscription cleanup


## Technical constraints
- Phaser 3.90 APIs: add.particles, add.rectangle, cameras.main.fadeIn


## Definition of done
- BootScene wired


## Non-functional requirements
- Handles destroyed to avoid leaks


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.description: Add effect context types and buildEffects.
acceptance_criteria: buildEffects returns handles for dust and ambient light only
buildEffects plays the fade transition through the context

steps.action: Append interface EffectHandle { destroy(): void } and interface EffectRenderContext { createEffect(spec: EffectSpec & { depth: number }): EffectHandle; playTransition(durationMs: number): void } with `import type { EffectSpec } from '../content/schema'` at top

Export buildEffects(ctx: EffectRenderContext, scene: SceneSpec): EffectHandle[]; for each effect of scene.effects ?? []: if type is 'transition' call ctx.playTransition(e.durationMs) else push ctx.createEffect({ ...e, depth: layerDepth('effects') }); return the handles

nodes.description: Create createPhaserEffectContext(scene) and use it in BootScene.create.
acceptance_criteria: Effects are built in BootScene.create from scene content
Effect handles are destroyed on scene shutdown

steps.action: Export createPhaserEffectContext(scene: Phaser.Scene): EffectRenderContext. createEffect: for 'dust' call scene.add.particles(x,y,'effect:dust',{quantity..., emitZone via area}) and setDepth(spec.depth); for 'ambientLight' scene.add.rectangle(0,0,w,h,parseInt(color.slice(1),16),alpha).setOrigin(0).setDepth(spec.depth); return { destroy } calling the object's destroy(). playTransition(ms) calls scene.cameras.main.fadeIn(ms)

Add private effects: EffectHandle[] = []; in create() after subscribe set this.effects = buildEffects(createPhaserEffectContext(this), scene) importing scene from '../runtime/content'; in the SHUTDOWN callback destroy each handle and reset the array
steps.expected: Effects created on create and destroyed on shutdown
